title: NASA’s SpaceX launch lights up the sky with a giant glowing jellyfish
summary: A SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket created a dazzling, jellyfish-shaped glow across the eastern United States as sunlight illuminated its exhaust during an early morning launch.
